import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Queue;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, c, f, rev;
        Edge() {}
        Edge(int too, int cc, int ff, int revv) {
            to = too;
            c = cc;
            f = ff;
            rev = revv;
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int f, s;
        Pair(int ff, int ss) {
            f = ff;
            s = ss;
        }
    }

    static int N = 11;
    static int INF = 1000000000;
    static int SIZE = 2 * N * N;
    static int s, t, n;
    static int d[] = new int[SIZE];
    static int ptr[] = new int[SIZE];
    static Edge g[][] = new Edge[SIZE][SIZE];
    static Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();

    static void addEdge(int v, int u, int cap) {
        g[v][g[v].length - 1] = new Edge(u, cap, 0, 0);
        g[u][g[u].length - 1] = new Edge(v, 0, 0, 0);
        g[v][g[v].length - 1].rev = g[u].length - 1;
        g[u][g[u].length - 1].rev = g[v].length - 1;
    }

    static boolean buildLevNet() {
        Arrays.fill(d, INF);
        d[s] = 0;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < g[v].length; i++) {
                int to = g[v][i].to;
                int cf = g[v][i].c - g[v][i].f;
                if (d[to] == INF && cf > 0) {
                    d[to] = d[v] + 1;
                    q.add(to);
                }
            }
        }
        return d[t] != INF;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int curFlow) {
        if (v == t) return curFlow;
        for (int i = ptr[v]; i < g[v].length; i++) {
            int to = g[v][i].to;
            int cf = g[v][i].c - g[v][i].f;
            int addFlow;
            if (d[to] == d[v] + 1 && cf > 0 && (addFlow = dfs(to, Math.min(curFlow, cf)))) {
                g[v][i].f += addFlow;
                g[to][g[v][i].rev].f -= addFlow;
                return addFlow;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinica() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (buildLevNet()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int add;
            while ((add = dfs(s, INF)) != 0)
                flow += add;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static int X[] = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int Y[] = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int dst[][][][] = new int[N][N][N][N];
    static int tbad;
    static char a[][] = new char[N][N];
    static char b[][] = new char[N][N];
    static Pair bad;
    static boolean check(Pair v) {
        return v.f >= 0 && v.f < n && v.s >= 0 && v.s < n && a[v.f][v.s] != 'Y' && a[v.f][v.s] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfs(int xs, int ys) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                Arrays.fill(dst[xs][ys][i][j], INF);
        dst[xs][ys][xs][ys] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (check(new Pair(i, j)) && dst[xs][ys][i][j] == INF)
                    dst[xs][ys][i][j] = dst[xs][ys][xs][ys] + 1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        tbad = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int px = -1, py = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = br.readLine().charAt(0);
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') px = i; py = j;
            }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                b[i][j] = br.readLine().charAt(0);
        bad = new Pair(px, py);
        bfs(px, py);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++)
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++)
                        if (check(new Pair(i, j)) && check(new Pair(i1, j1)) && dst[i][j][i1][j1] <= dst[px][py][i1][j1])
                            dst[i][j][i1][j1] = Math.min(dst[i][j][i1][j1], tbad);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++)
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++)
                        if (check(new Pair(i, j)) && check(new Pair(i1, j1)) && dst[i][j][i1][j1] <= dst[px][py][i1][j1])
                            bfs(i, j);
        s = 0;
        t = 2 * n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] != '0') addEdge(s, i * n + j + 1, a[i][j] - '0');
                if (b[i][j] != '0') addEdge(i * n + j + 1 + n * n, t, b[i][j] - '0');
            }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++)
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++)
                        if (check(new Pair(i, j)) && check(new Pair(i1, j1)) && dst[i][j][i1][j1] <= dst[px][py][i1][j1])
                            addEdge(i * n + j + 1, i1 * n + j1 + 1 + n * n, INF);
        pw.println(dinica());
        pw.close();
    }
}
